# Tastelist.co.za

> > A South African recipe-sharing community platform combining video recipes, meal planning, and grocery shopping deals from local supermarkets.

Tastelist.co.za is a recipe discovery and sharing platform tailored for South African home cooks, featuring user-generated video recipes, meal planning tools, and integrated grocery flyers from major retailers like Shoprite, Checkers, and Boxer. The platform emphasizes community engagement through recipe ratings, user profiles, and diverse cuisine categories spanning breakfast, dinner, desserts, and international dishes.

## Core Platform

- [Tastelist.co.za: Simple recipes, friends and great inspiration!](https://www.tastelist.co.za): Homepage showcasing recipe-sharing community with cooking, baking, and video recipes
- [All recipe categories in one place!](https://www.tastelist.co.za/categories): Recipe directory organizing categories, cuisines, meal types, and dietary filters
- [About us](https://www.tastelist.co.za/about-us): Company mission and values of Tastelist recipe cooking community platform

## Video Recipes

- [Easiest Lasagna Ever](https://www.tastelist.co.za/recipe/easiest-lasagna-ever/B4oZZ42Y9KpA3iUEG3JO): Video recipe for easy lasagna with mozzarella and parmesan, 60 min prep
- [The best ever carbonara recipe](https://www.tastelist.co.za/recipe/the-best-ever-carbonara-recipe/m0hIckvhz6s21k1WED8B): Quick Italian carbonara recipe with bacon and spaghetti, 10 min prep
- [Aussie chocolate slice recipe](https://www.tastelist.co.za/recipe/aussie-chocolate-slice-recipe/o1EhC4E7tOC46mnt8N5h): Video recipe for Australian chocolate slice dessert, 45 min baking
- [Homemade Chicken Chow Mein Recipe](https://www.tastelist.co.za/recipe/homemade-chicken-chow-mein-recipe/_nQIkrSWungT8iMweVpp): Video recipe for homemade Asian chicken chow mein noodles, 35 min prep

- [Specials, Deals, Catalogues and brochures online](https://www.tastelist.co.za/flyers): Grocery flyers and weekly specials from SA supermarkets: Shoprite, Checkers, Boxer
